acceptance: The cause is reproduced and identified (which cached files, from which generator).
Reuse of generated data is refused or regenerated when its generator version or manifest does not match, with a test.
Whether any published bundle used stale cached data is checked and reported.
context:
Found during site documentation verification on 2026-11-14. Guardrails: work in a linked worktree (make worktree-create, then make agent-write-preflight); never edit the primary clone. Related items share one feature branch and PR where their files overlap. No live-cloud runs and no credentials in Git or logs; heavy work only through lock-taking entry points or make heavy-run after make heavy-status. Follow the comment policy and add a changelog.d fragment for user-facing changes. Re-verify every cited file and line before acting; they are hints. Stop and report rather than widen scope.

Possibly the same cause as mcp-sf1-run-incomplete-without-error-20261114 (Q18-like 56 against expected rows at SF1).
description: Problem: a TPC-H SF1 run using the shared default output directory ~/Developer/benchmark_runs failed Q18 row-count validation (57 expected, 56 returned); the same run with its own output directory passed. Reused generated data is not checked for being stale or from another generator version, so results can be silently wrong.
